preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 10**5 for n in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[1::2] if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(x, int) and 1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in a) for a in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[2::2] if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the sequence a consists of n integers, each between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum([int(line.strip()) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[1::2] if line.strip()]) <= 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each line of output is a valid integer.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_lines[i] == str(sum_weight_of_subsegments(a)) for i, a in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case i, the output line equals the sum of weights of all subsegments of the sequence a, where weight is the count of unordered pairs (j, k) with j < k and a[j] == a[k] within that subsegment.
